LanguageData.LP_TrollAppearance.label: troll giant body and tusks
LanguageData.LP_TrollAppearance.description: The tusks and tall body of a troll. Note: this gene isn't just cosmetic; it determines the troll's 1.5× actual body size, and removing it returns carry capacity, food intake, chance to be hit and so on to normal human levels. The green skin, robust build, pointed ears, heavy jaw, thick brows and hairless look come from vanilla xenogenes. Body size grows with age; as an adult the actual body and the entire character render reach 1.5× an ordinary person. Ordinary clothing, armor and weapons can still be worn and displayed. The bigger the body, the stronger the health and melee (see giant-body rules: adult total health ×125%, melee damage ×115%).
LanguageData.LP_TrollAppearance.customEffectDescripti: Adult actual body size (affects carry capacity, food intake, chance to be hit) and overall character appearance: ×150%.
Giant stomach: adult max food ×150%, one meal lasts longer.
Adds troll tusks; the rest of the appearance comes from a combination of vanilla genes.
Keeps normal humanlike gear anchors, so regular clothing and armor can be worn.
LanguageData.LP_TrollRegeneration.label: troll regeneration
LanguageData.LP_TrollRegeneration.description: Troll flesh regenerates at an astonishing rate. While food is at least 50%, it repairs 0.5 injury about every 4 seconds (bleeding wounds first) and gradually replenishes lost blood; removes one old scar about every 5 days (except the brain); lost external parts grow back, arms and legs in about 3 days, small parts like fingers and eyes in about 1 day. Repairs cost extra food; hunger rate ×200% while regenerating, ×120% normally. After taking fire or acid damage, or while on fire, regeneration stops for 6 hours. After death, if not hurt by fire or acid in the 6 hours before death and the brain is intact, the corpse stays fresh for about 1 day and then revives in place; a corpse that's burned, cremated, butchered or rotten won't revive.
LanguageData.LP_TrollRegeneration.customEffectDescrip: Hunger rate: ×120% normally, ×200% while regenerating; each point of injury repaired costs an extra 0.005 food.
Heals quickly when fed, stopping bleeding and replenishing lost blood first; immunity gain speed ×150%.
Removes one old scar about every 5 days (except the brain).
External parts grow back: arms and legs about 3 days, fingers, eyes and similar about 1 day; internal organs don't grow back.
After taking fire or acid damage, or while on fire, regeneration stops for 6 hours.
Revives about 1 day after death (can be turned off or limited in mod settings); fire, cremation, butchering, rot or a destroyed brain prevent revival.
